items.recommendation: channel_strip.kit.vixi: fixed vertical flow with named slots in signal-flow order: [input_section] [eq_section] [dynamics_section] [aux_section] [pan_slot] [routing_buttons] [mute_solo_row] [fader_slot] [scribble_strip]. Each slot is a ParameterGroupZone. Width: fixed 72px (scalable via ui_scale). Height: full panel height.
master_section.kit.vixi: right-aligned panel with master fader (LongThrowFader), bus meter (LedBarMeter x2 L/R), monitor source selector (RotaryKnob), dim/mute buttons.
parameter_group_zone: CID_FRAME (1px) top+bottom border lines, CID_STATUS label (type.ramp[0], 8px, top-left corner), child slot area. Used for EQ, Dynamics, Aux sections within a ChannelStripLayout.

led_bar_meter: vertical bar, N segments (default 20), each segment = 1px gap + colored rect. Level = Permyriad input. Segment colors resolved via LedMeterColorSegment threshold tokens. Peak-hold segment blinks at CID_DANGER (1Hz = 120 ticks on/off). Width: 8px per meter. Zero heap — segment count is const.

long_throw_fader: vertical drag-track widget. Track height = 80px (scales with ui_scale). Cap = 12x4px rect. Value = Permyriad (0 to 13000 where 10000=unity). Snap at 10000 (0dB unity). dB label rendered at presentation layer from integer. Edict: set_fader(ch: u8, pos: Permyriad). CID_FRAME track, CID_TITLE cap, CID_ACCENT at unity snap.

rotary_knob: 20x20px circle body (CID_BAR), indicator line (CID_TITLE), optional arc track (CID_FRAME). Range declared as (min: Permyriad, max: Permyriad, detents: [Permyriad;8]). Drag vertical for value change. Edict: set_knob(id: u16, value: Permyriad). Double-tap to reset to detent[0].

mute_solo_token: two rows of small backlit-style toggle buttons. Mute (M): CID_ACCENT active, CID_STATUS inactive. Solo (S): CID_DANGER active, CID_STATUS inactive. Width: full channel strip width / 2 each.
group_assign_token: compact button grid (2x4 for 8 buses). Each button = 12x8px. State = bitmask. CID_MARK assigned, CID_BAR unassigned. Edict: set_group_assign(ch: u8, groups: u8).
